_comment: Hand edits on top of the OpenStreetMap draft of Aalborg (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py), BUILDOUT O5 batch 2 (2026-10-29). Drafted from OSM only so far; facts from DSB's or Banedanmark's station page, photos or a walk go here with their source. Level names are placeholders until a plan or signage names them.

levels.name: Forhal (station hall) at John F. Kennedys Plads
levels.name_source: DSB station page https://www.dsb.dk/trafikinformation/stationer/aalborg/, read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract /home/claude/osmfacts_dk/860000020.json), read 2026-10-30

sources.note: Danmarks Højdemodel, © Klimadatastyrelsen, CC BY 4.0: building and roof heights and the ground (3D research pass; pack in data/stations/research/860000020).
Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 (facts): platform heights (3D research pass; data/stations/research/banedanmark_platforms_DK.csv).

changelog.what: First draft from OSM (BUILDOUT O5 batch 2).

Platform heights from Banedanmark Netredegørelse 2027, Bilag 3.6 (facts); 18 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/860000020).

Withheld after the final research pass: platform 0–1's middle node isn't on the walking graph and two amenities are unreachable. The edits keep the research (platform heights, structures, entrances, amenities) for when OSM or a walk adds what's missing.
